shots.name: ask-box-empty
shots.expect: js:document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-block]')?.dataset.planStatus === 'paused' && !!document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-ask-box] textarea') && document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-ask-box] textarea').placeholder === 'What would you like to ask? (optional)' && [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=plan-ask-box] button')].map(b=>b.textContent.trim()).join('|') === 'Cancel|Send' && !document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-pause-actions]') && !document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-block]').dataset.handoff

shots.name: ask-box-text

actions.type: Is adding 12,500 tokens enough to finish?

shots.expect: js:document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-block]')?.dataset.planStatus === 'paused' && document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-ask-box] textarea')?.value === 'Is adding 12,500 tokens enough to finish?' && [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=plan-ask-box] button')].map(b=>b.textContent.trim()).join('|') === 'Cancel|Send' && !document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-block]').dataset.handoff

shots.name: ask-pending
shots.expect: js:document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-block]')?.dataset.planStatus === 'paused' && document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-block]').dataset.handoff === 'pending' && document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-block]').className.indexOf('opacity-60') >= 0 && document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-handoff-pending]')?.textContent.trim() === 'The assistant is looking into this.' && document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-block]').querySelectorAll('button:not([aria-expanded])').length === 0 && [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=plan-ask-line]')].filter(e=>e.textContent.trim()==='You asked the assistant about this plan.').length === 1 && !document.body.textContent.includes('[Plan paused]')

shots.name: ask-pending-after-reply
shots.expect: js:document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-block]')?.dataset.planStatus === 'paused' && document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-block]').dataset.handoff === 'pending' && document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-handoff-pending]')?.textContent.trim() === 'The assistant will look at this after its current reply.' && document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-block]').querySelectorAll('button:not([aria-expanded])').length === 0 && [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=plan-ask-line]')].filter(e=>e.textContent.trim()==='You asked the assistant about this plan.').length === 0

shots.name: ask-failed-timeout
shots.expect: js:document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-block]')?.dataset.planStatus === 'paused' && document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-ask-error]')?.textContent.includes("The assistant didn't get to your question within 10 minutes.") && [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=plan-ask-error] button')].some(b=>b.textContent.trim()==='Retry') && [...document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-block]').querySelectorAll('[data-testid=plan-pause-actions] button')].map(b=>b.textContent.trim()).join('|') === 'Stop|Add budget'

shots.name: ask-failed-reply
shots.expect: js:document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-block]')?.dataset.planStatus === 'paused' && document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-ask-error]')?.textContent.includes('The assistant couldn\'t answer your question: The provider returned an error (529: overloaded).') && [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=plan-ask-error] button')].some(b=>b.textContent.trim()==='Retry') && [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=plan-ask-line]')].filter(e=>e.textContent.trim()==='You asked the assistant about this plan.').length === 1

shots.name: ask-line-text
shots.expect: js:document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-block]')?.dataset.planStatus === 'paused' && document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-block]').dataset.handoff === 'pending' && [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=plan-ask-line]')].map(e=>e.textContent.trim()).join('|') === 'You asked the assistant about this plan: Is adding 12,500 tokens enough to finish, or should I stop here?' && !document.body.textContent.includes('[Plan paused]') && !document.body.textContent.includes('user-question')
